tools.name: search_plugins
tools.description: Find Claude plugins by what they do. Every word of the query must appear in the plugin's name, description, category or tags; name matches come first. Filter by category or by source (official = Anthropic and partners in Anthropic's marketplaces).

tools.name: get_plugin
tools.description: Details for one plugin by its slug (from search_plugins): description, source, licence, stars, its skills, and install commands for Claude Code (and the Claude app for Anthropic's plugins).

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Find individual skills inside Claude plugins by what they do, e.g. 'contract review' or 'call prep'. Returns each skill's plugin and the command to run it.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All plugin categories in the directory with how many plugins each has.
